summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held August 7, 2026. Shareholders approved six proposals: increasing authorized share capital, amending the memorandum and articles to give Class B shares 100 votes each versus 1 vote for Class A, shortening general meeting notice period, adding chairman's casting vote, and adopting exclusive jurisdiction/arbitration provisions. The EGM had 62.17% of outstanding shares represented, and all items passed. This is a routine corporate governance and capital structure update, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms or strategic event are involved; watch for potential impact on voting control and future share issuance.
